{{Quote|The ''Vigilance'' destroyed a Republic cruiser not long ago. Brilliant show, but apparently escape pods jettisoned from the cruiser, made it planetside.|Colonel Valda|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic" />}}
The '''''Vigilance''''' was a warship of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] that participated in the [[invasion of Taris]] during the [[Galactic War]]. The ''Vigilance'' destroyed a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]], though [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]] from the ship managed to land on [[Taris/Legends|Taris's]] surface.|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic" />
